name: Project Polygon
detailed_description:
[Welcome to Project Polygon!]

Project Polygon invites you to an adventure-filled world with a unique blend of Battle Royale and Platform games. Engage in exciting battles with multiple players simultaneously, utilizing different skills across various platforms. Players who complete the platforms the fastest advance to the next round, intensifying the thrill of the game.

[Various Game Modes:]
Get ready to be a pirate in one round and a farmer in another. But beware, you might find yourself in the Caribbean one moment and in Japan the next. Looking for a simple run? No, this game is not for you then. It's for those who want to run while attacking others and driving their friends crazy. Don't just focus on combat; also complete the platforms quickly and strategically to gain an advantage.

[Don't Forget!]
For players who provide valuable feedback while the game is in Early Access, we have a surprise. We plan to add the names of these players into the game and reward them with special gifts.

Welcome to Project Polygon, get ready for the adventure!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 or AMD Radeon HD 7950
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
